items.name: River Rafting
items.alt: River Rafting at The Samsaara, Shivpuri
items.text: Shivpuri is Rishikesh's rafting capital. We arrange rafting on the Ganga for individuals and groups.

items.name: Beach-side Camping
items.alt: Beach-side Camping at The Samsaara, Shivpuri
items.text: Our signature experience: tents on the river beach, starry skies and the sound of the Ganga.

items.name: Bonfire Nights
items.alt: Bonfire Nights at The Samsaara, Shivpuri
items.text: Evenings around the fire with music, snacks and stories by the river.

items.name: Swimming Pool
items.alt: Swimming Pool at The Samsaara, Shivpuri
items.text: Cool off in the pool after a day of rafting and adventure.

items.name: Garden Swings & Group Games
items.alt: Garden Swings & Group Games at The Samsaara, Shivpuri
items.text: Lawns, swings and thatched gazebos for beach volleyball, indoor and outdoor games and team activities.

items.name: Karaoke & Music
items.alt: Karaoke & Music at The Samsaara, Shivpuri
items.text: An outdoor stage, lights and music for karaoke nights, DJ evenings and celebrations.

items.name: Pre-wedding Shoots
items.alt: Pre-wedding Shoots at The Samsaara, Shivpuri
items.text: Fairy-lit trees, the river, the hills and golden-hour light make a beautiful backdrop for your shoot.

items.name: River Front
items.alt: River Front at The Samsaara, Shivpuri
items.text: Walk down to the Ganga, watch the rapids and soak in the Himalayan foothills around Shivpuri.
